title: Triage a rotated service log
prompt:
Inspect logs/current.log and logs/archive.log.
Each valid line is timestamp|service|level|request_id|status. Ignore blank lines, lines beginning #,
and malformed lines (exactly five fields; level INFO/WARN/ERROR; status is three decimal digits).
Deduplicate by request_id: keep the lexicographically latest timestamp, then prefer current.log
over archive.log on ties. Output records (retained count), errors (ERROR count), warnings (WARN count),
failed_ids (status >=500, sorted), service_counts (all retained by service), and latest_timestamp
(maximum retained timestamp). Timestamps are sortable UTC strings. Example: a newer INFO record
replaces an older ERROR with the same ID; count the retained record only.

Write a UTF-8 JSON object to submission.json. Do not modify the supplied inputs. Run python public_tests.py for a structure check, then call submit. Extra object keys are ignored; all listed fields are required. All paths are relative to /workspace; no network or third-party packages are needed.

files.public_tests.py:
import json
from pathlib import Path
answer=json.loads(Path('submission.json').read_text())
assert isinstance(answer,dict)
assert set(['records', 'errors', 'warnings', 'failed_ids', 'service_counts', 'latest_timestamp']).issubset(answer), 'Missing required fields'
print('Public structure check passed; values are independently graded.')
